scope.purpose: Exact-name mechanics and provenance refresh while preserving existing PQ relationship identities.

evidence.use: Maintained Super Soul catalogue corroborates character, effects, magnitudes, durations, Limit Bursts, and PQ endpoints for the selected records.
Independent contemporary discussion corroborates the core effects for 206, 208, 210, and 211 and related Extra Pack 4 Super Soul behavior.
Independent community reference corroborates the support-oriented triggers/effects for 206, 207, and 208.
DLC listing corroborates PQ129–131 placement of the selected Super Souls.

limits: Exact reward/drop probabilities and Ultimate-Finish gating were not inferred from catalogue or community listings.
Community sources were used as corroboration, not as justification for changing canonical PQ relationship identities.
Record 206's 4-bar Ki reduction is retained as corroborated community/mechanics detail; no engine-level test was claimed.
Record 209's self-sleep trigger is documented separately from its temporary damage reduction; no additional Ki effect was inferred.
Record 211's +1.8% per-second health recovery and 30-second duration were retained from the maintained catalogue; no extra stacking behavior was inferred.
